subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Maya civilization flourished for over 2,000 years (approximately 2000 BC to AD 1500).
• The Maya controlled territories covering about 120,000 square miles.
• This area included parts of present-day Mexico, Guatemala, and Belize.
• One of the civilization's major centers was the ancient city of Tikal.
• Tikal was located in what is now northern Guatemala.
prompt: The student wants to specify the location of Tikal. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Maya civilization flourished from approximately 2000 BC to AD 1500.
choices.B: Tikal, one of the major centers of Maya civilization, covered about 120,000 square miles.
choices.C: Tikal, one of the major centers of Maya civilization, was located in what is now northern Guatemala.
choices.D: The Maya controlled territories including parts of present-day Mexico, Guatemala, and Belize.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The sentence specifies the location of Tikal, noting that it was located in what is now northern Guatemala.
